enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Sleep. Turn to side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing university notes and laptop into bag
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to wardrobe. Open wardrobe door. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Walk to desk. Pick up art history notes. Put notes into backpack. Pick up laptop. Put laptop into backpack. Zip backpack closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast of toast and coffee with Member 1 and Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1 and Member 3. Say 'Good morning.' Take bread from breadbox. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Take mug from cupboard. Fill mug with water from kettle. Pour water into coffee maker. Take coffee jar. Spoon coffee into mug. Pour hot water. Stir. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Take toast. Spread butter. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Talk with Member 1 and Member 3.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and reviewing art history notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open art history notes. Read notes. Highlight key points. Turn page. Write summary in notebook. Turn page. Read more. Underline terms. Turn page. Close notes. Stand up. Stretch.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Final check of laptop, art history notes and cafe uniform before leaving
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up backpack. Open backpack. Check laptop inside. Check art history notes. Check cafe uniform. Zip backpack. Put on backpack. Walk to door. Open door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash Caulfield campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Hold backpack on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Art History lecture and tutorial at university
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Write more notes. Turn page. Check time. Listen. Write. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Coffee break on campus, rereading lecture notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to campus cafe. Order coffee. Pay. Take coffee. Sit at table. Open notes. Read notes. Sip coffee. Turn page. Read. Finish coffee. Stand up. Walk away.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Creative Writing workshop and sharing drafted pieces
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into workshop room. Sit in circle. Take out draft. Listen to instructor. Read draft aloud. Listen to feedback. Write notes. Listen to others. Comment on peer's work. Write more. Pack up. Stand. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to food court. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay. Take sandwich. Find table. Sit. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw trash. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library and drafting writing portfolio pieces
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to library. Find empty desk. Sit. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open writing portfolio file. Type sentences. Read over. Delete sentence. Type more. Check word count. Save file. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the cafe for a work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Look out window. Check phone. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Adjust volume. Bus stops. Stand. Walk to door. Exit. Walk to cafe.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time cafe shift at the counter and coffee machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into cafe. Greet manager. Clock in. Put on apron. Wash hands. Stand at counter. Greet customer. Take order. Press buttons on register. Take payment. Make coffee. Steam milk. Pour coffee. Hand to customer. Wipe counter. Repeat. Take break. Eat snack. Return to counter. Clean coffee machine. Clock out. Take off apron.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Adjust volume. Look at watch. Bus stops. Stand. Walk to door. Exit. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a late dinner with Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Greet Member 3. Say 'Hi, how was your day?' Open fridge. Take out leftovers. Put leftovers in microwave. Press start. Wait. Microwave beeps. Take out plate. Sit at table. Eat with Member 3. Talk about day.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and drafting creative writing on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open creative writing document. Type sentences. Read. Delete. Type more. Check word count. Save. Close laptop. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Read. Put book down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and checking phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Scroll. Comment. Scroll. Put phone down. Close eyes. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
